files.role: Exact V2_1 reader metadata/projection implementation inside a private reader child module. The parent publicly reexports three projection constructors and reexports metadata functions pub(crate); other pub declarations are implementation interfaces, not independently external API.
ranges: SPDX/imports connect BTreeMap/Arc, core Schema/errors, ColumnInfo and pb21 grammar, file protobuf, shared structural normalization/projection, raw/cached/index metadata and ConcreteFileVersion. No IO scheduler, decompressor, plugin registry or environment input is used in this exact grammar validator.
Private required borrows Option<&T>, returns the same reference or InvalidInput source naming Lance v2.1, supplied label and missing nested encoding. It does not clone payloads or supply defaults.

Private validate_compressive_encoding requires compression oneof. Flat, InlineBitpacking and Constant immediately succeed without inspecting bit widths/data fields/literal size. Variable requires/revalidates offsets; OutOfLineBitpacking requires/revalidates values; Fsst likewise values. Local recursive validation has no explicit depth limit; external protobuf decode limits remain a separate concern.

Dictionary first requires and recursively validates indices, then items. Missing/invalid indices short-circuit before items. num_dictionary_items and index/value relationships are not checked. This is grammar validation, not decoding data bytes.

RLE requires values and run_lengths present before validating their shapes. Values must be direct Flat with bits_per_value 8/16/32/64 and data=None; lengths must be direct Flat8 with data=None. Flat.data is an optional BufferCompression descriptor, not the encoded bytes (protos/encodings_v2_1.proto:419-425). Wrappers, 128-bit values, any present buffer-compression descriptor (including a default descriptor), and any other shape fail InvalidInput requiring flat values and flat u8 run lengths. It does not inspect encoded runs or row totals.

ByteStreamSplit, General, FixedSizeList and PackedStruct each require and recursively validate their values child; scheme/level, dimensions, packed field widths and other properties are not inspected. VariablePackedStruct is rejected unconditionally as outside v2.1 grammar, even empty. Missing compression variant is InvalidInput.

validate_page_layout MiniBlock rejects has_large_chunk=true before nested checks. If false, validate optional rep then def, required value, optional dictionary, in order. Optional missing rep/def/dictionary are accepted. It does not inspect buffers, chunk counts, level widths or data values.

FullZip requires/revalidates value_compression only. Constant accepts only inline_value=None and both rep_compression/def_compression=None; any inline_value presence is first error (including empty), then compressed-level presence error, otherwise succeeds. Constant-layout acceptance includes all-null form even though writer policy list has no constant() mechanism. Other Constant fields are not inspected here.

Blob requires inner_layout with its own missing-inner InvalidInput, then recursively validates the same exact version. Nested Blob wrappers have no local recursion cap. Sparse is always InvalidInput outside v2.1 grammar; absent page layout has a distinct missing-layout error.

decode_column enumerates every page: shared syntax decode PageLayout, exact validate_page_layout, then shared build_page_info. First syntax/grammar failure precedes that page alignment checks. Fallibly collect pages then shared build_column_info decodes column encoding. No local ColumnEncoding variant validator, physical data read or schema comparison. Empty page list still requires a valid column-encoding envelope (rust/lance-file/src/reader/structural.rs:118-155).

decode_column_metadata enumerates and checked-converts zero-based indices to u32, decodes in order and collects Result<Vec<Arc<ColumnInfo>>>. Message says more than u32::MAX columns; actual guard is per-index and permits index u32::MAX. No parallelism; first error drops constructed Vec.

projection_from_field_ids forwards shared leaf traversal. Whole-schema projection first creates parent module mapping from entire schema. Name projection passes original full schema and its mapping to shared schema.project wrapper, so indices preserve original file numbering. Unknown mapping entries remain silently omitted until downstream checks; these functions add no new validation.

finish_metadata requires literal footer pair(2,1) before any alignment or grammar work; wrong pair returns VersionConflict with actual raw footer numbers and exact version message. Then validate_global_buffers and decode all column metadata in that order.

On success construct CachedFileMetadata moving raw schema, original protobuf columns, decoded infos, declared row count, descriptors, all four byte-accounting fields, file size and retained global bytes. Preserve literal major/minor; set exact ConcreteFileVersion::V2_1. Full metadata and normalized descriptors both remain retained. This function does not reconcile schema, total rows, counts, file bounds or byte-accounting totals and performs no IO.
validate_global_buffers delegates shared64-byte position-alignment check; no size/file-bound check at this boundary.

finish_metadata_index requires enum V2_1; mismatch uses actual enum standard footer tuple for VersionConflict. Matching identity then checks global-buffer alignment and returns index unchanged. Does not load/decode individual columns or establish projection eligibility/length. Global alignment error follows version check.
cfg(test) test_projection_length delegates shared structural synthetic-length helper; unlike V2_0 helper it inherits surplus-index checking. It is a helper, not a test case.

Private cfg(test) grammar_tests imports pb21 types. rejects_nested_variable_packed_struct builds an empty VariablePackedStruct wrapped in General with compression=None and values=Some(Box(child)); it tests traversal through General, not codec scheme validity.

Wrap in FullZip with other fields Default; validate_page_layout must error and display contain Variable packed struct compression is not part. The test does not assert the error variant, use bytes/IO, or test a valid packed payload. No other local grammar fixtures; no unsafe or async functions.

Private cfg(test) grammar_tests imports compression/layout types. flat(bits) constructs Flat with requested width and data=None without validation. No helper asserts the width itself.

rejects_nested_variable_width_rle builds RLE Flat32 values and Flat16 run lengths, nests as Dictionary indices with Flat32 items/count1, nests that in FullZip/default other fields. The disallowed shape here is sixteen-bit run lengths, not actual variable-width data payload.

Assert validate_page_layout errors and string contains flat values and flat u8 run lengths. No variant assertion, byte decode, file fixture or positive RLE matrix; nested wrapper traversal is what this test demonstrates. No unsafe/async functions in this file.
